name: bitmovin-encoding-vod
description: Portable Bitmovin VOD encoding skill packaged for Codex as a local plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Create and start a Bitmovin VOD encoding (H.264 per-title, fixed ladder, AV1 UGC, sports clips)
interface.longDescription: Walks the user through creating and starting a Bitmovin VOD encoding end-to-end via the Encoding Templates API and the Bitmovin Python SDK. Renders Jinja templates from a small parameter file, validates against the published Encoding Template JSON schema, submits and polls until the encoding is FINISHED, and prints manifest URLs. Covers H.264 per-title (algorithm-picked ladder), H.264 fixed ladder, AV1 per-title for UGC (progressive MP4), and a hardware-accelerated H.264 sports-clips template tuned for time-to-publish.
defaultPrompt: Run a per-title H.264 VOD encoding on Bitmovin
Set up a fixed-ladder H.264 VOD encoding on Bitmovin
